system: Audit this final H3 composition against its typed responsibilities. Return findings only for clear contradictions, not aesthetic preferences, prose length, optional creative choices, or unknown video quality. The supplied fragments are the actual final narrative, with typed subject/reference IDs printed explicitly. Read their full context and the target subject kinds: a floor or other environment must not become a moving vehicle merely because it is Subject 1. A source structure/storyboard provides only its declared camera/cutting/planning properties, not its people, objects, world, lighting or palette. A placed subject adds to the edited scene; a replacement takes over the identified source figure. Both must actually appear in prose/actions, not only definitions. Accepted target identity outranks raw source observations. Property-only voice, music-style, beat and sound-texture references condition a new sound; they do not play the original recording. BGM music references with partially_copy copy the supplied signal, and prose must not deny that. Music=N/A under no_added_music only prohibits adding a new score; it does not cancel an explicitly copied BGM. References with no actual dialogue do not authorize inventing spoken words. For actual first/last frame responsibilities, the whole supplied still is that frame: reference-sheet panels/labels/background are frame pixels, not packaging to silently remove. Moving one panel within an otherwise preserved sheet is legitimate. A recorded aspect-ratio warning alone is not a contradiction and does not authorize a crop. Do not invent preparation IO or assume its execution. Every finding must identify an actual fragment and an exact nonempty quote from that fragment demonstrating the contradiction, plus the implicated target subject ID when relevant. Empty findings means no clear supported contradiction was found, not proof of overall quality. No Markdown.

fragments.shot:shot-1:description: Deep blackness fills the image at first, with no readable surface, horizon, or background detail. The <Subject:car> is present only as a dim, low mass near the center, its outline broken by shadow and its body indistinguishable from the surrounding dark. As the darkness thins by degrees, a faint gray sheen touches the leading edge and the upper contour, enough to suggest metal and glass without revealing color, trim, or interior detail. The surrounding space remains mostly empty and unlit, so the car seems to emerge from the darkness itself rather than travel through a described environment. A low engine rumble is a continuous presence at the bottom of the scene, felt more than localized, and it gains body as the shape becomes easier to read. No other objects, people, or lettering appear.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:0: Deep darkness fills the image. The <Subject:car> is barely visible as a dim, low silhouette.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:1: A low engine rumble rises from near silence.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:2: A faint sheen reveals the <Subject:car> leading edge and upper contour.
fragments.shot:shot-1:event:3: The camera holds a static shot.
fragments.shot:shot-2:description: The <Subject:car> advances steadily toward the viewer, its front body growing larger and clearer without ever becoming brightly lit. Faint light now catches the hood line, the edge of the windshield, and the front corners, revealing a smooth dark surface and a restrained metallic reflection. The background stays near-black, with only a soft gradient of gray behind the car, so the vehicle remains separated from the void. Small shifts in the reflection travel across the bodywork as it moves, and the low engine rumble fills out with a deeper, rounder tone. The car keeps a steady pace and occupies more of the image by the end, its shape still simple and uncluttered. The contrast stays low, with highlights limited to narrow edges and the rest of the body sinking back into shadow. No additional objects or lettering are introduced.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:0: The low engine rumble grows fuller and steadier.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:1: The <Subject:car> pulls forward, its front body emerging into faint light.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:2: Faint reflections slide along the hood and windshield edge as the <Subject:car> advances.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:3: The <Subject:car> fills more of the dark space, its leading edges clearly lit.
fragments.shot:shot-2:event:4: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.
fragments.soundscape: A continuous low engine rumble, starting faint and growing fuller as the car advances.
fragments.summary: A <Subject:car> pulls forward out of darkness as a low engine rumble grows.
